docs/coop/design-corrections/discovery-d: A version-1 provenance record is a historical record and is not converted here.

TWO LANES, made explicit after root probe 1 (this converter previously read no version at all and
    relabelled ANY input as version 2). READING a historical record is not the same act as CONVERTING one for
    a current operation. Schema validation and read APIs still admit both versions
    (SUPPORTED_PROVENANCE_VERSIONS); this converter is a CURRENT-OPERATION boundary and admits only
    CURRENT_PROVENANCE_VERSION. A version-1 record is refused explicitly as
    PROVENANCE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED:1, never silently relabelled and never upgraded by inventing a
    markerCountBasis or an observed-inventory count for rows that carry neither. A version this kit does not
    define at all is PROVENANCE_VERSION_UNKNOWN, and a non-integer version (a bool included) is
    PROVENANCE_VERSION_SHAPE. The security wrapper maps all three onto its existing BOUNDARY_INVENTORY
    Reject detail; no new public code is minted.
